packageRules.description: Reimplements group:allNonMajor plus digest updates, since the preset's minor/patch match misses digests
A minor bump on a 0.x cargo dep is a breaking change under semver, so it gets its own PR and a human reviewer. Must stay ordered after the grouping rule above, since later packageRules win.

ADR-0025 keeps this pin and Cargo.toml's rust-version equal, so bumping it raises the version oakum supports. That is a distribution decision and gets a human. The mise manager sets packageName to a bare 'rust'; other tools there use repo slugs, so copying this rule needs that field checked.
